relationships.subject: TrkB.T1
relationships.evidence_quote: TrkB.T1 KO reduces colitis-induced upregulation of Tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α) mRNA but not upregulation of interleukin (IL)-6 mRNA in the spinal cord

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: TNF-α elicits Ca 2+ transients in capsaicin-sensitive as well as capsaicin-insensitive DRG neurons, and increases Piezo2 and CGRP expression in DRG neurons via distinct signaling pathways

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: TNF-α elicits Ca 2+ transients in capsaicin-sensitive as well as capsaicin-insensitive DRG neurons, and increases Piezo2 and CGRP expression in DRG neurons via distinct signaling pathways

relationships.subject: PI3K/Akt pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: TNFα-or colitis-induced Piezo2 upregulation in L4 DRG neurons is mediated by or associated with the PI3K/Akt pathway that does not participate in CGRP upregulation

key_findings: TrkB.T1 KO attenuates colitis-induced hind paw mechanical hypersensitivity and Piezo2/CGRP increases in primary afferents, via reduced spinal TNF-alpha.
TrkB.T1 KO does not change TRPV1 in L4 DRG, explaining no effect on thermal hyperalgesia.
